jobs.title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager, Mako EMEA
jobs.description:
Location:
Amsterdam, Netherlands

Why join us?

At Stryker, Mako Robotics is transforming orthopaedic surgery through technology, data and innovation. As we continue to accelerate robotic adoption across EMEA, we are looking for an experienced marketing leader to shape the future of one of our fastest-growing strategic platforms.

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for someone who thrives in complex international environments and enjoys bringing people together around a shared commercial vision.

Joint Replacement:
Joint replacement | Stryker

What You'll Do

As Senior Brand Marketing Manager, Mako EMEA, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional brand strategy that drives adoption, customer engagement and long-term portfolio growth.

Working across Europe and in close partnership with Global Marketing, Product Management, Sales Leadership and local marketing teams, you will ensure Mako remains at the centre of our Joint Replacement growth strategy.

You will:

Develop and execute the long-term EMEA Mako brand strategy
Integrate Mako into annual marketing plans across the Knee and Hip portfolios
Lead pan-EMEA marketing campaigns and customer engagement initiatives
Partner with US upstream and downstream marketing teams to align global and regional priorities
Build strong relationships with local marketing teams, commercial leaders and key opinion leaders
Develop scalable marketing assets and programmes that can be localised across Europe
Support product lifecycle management, launches and portfolio growth initiatives
Analyse market performance and identify opportunities to accelerate growth
Mentor and develop Brand Marketing team members
Influence senior stakeholders across multiple business units within a complex matrix organisation

Who We're Looking For

You are an experienced marketing leader with the credibility to influence senior stakeholders across functions, countries and business units.

You bring:

Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred)
10+ years of professional experience
Significant experience within medical devices
Strong background in Capital Equipment and/or Robotics marketing or commercial roles
Previous people leadership experience
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking
Experience working successfully in complex international matrix organisations
Fluent English communication skills

Why this role?

This is more than a marketing leadership position.

You'll play a central role in shaping the future of robotic surgery across EMEA, influencing commercial strategy, partnering with global teams, and helping drive the continued growth of one of Stryker's most important strategic platforms.

Netherlands Pay Ranges:

Netherlands: €83.100 - €154.400 EUR Annual

At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.

If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

jobs.description:
About us

At Design Bridge and Partners, part of WPP, we design brands with the power to move. Pulling people towards them with an irresistible force that compels and connects. With 900 creative minds across 17 studios worldwide, diverse in expertise, experience, backgrounds and beliefs, we are united in our ambition to achieve real impact for our clients’ brands benefiting their business, people and the planet.

With expertise across brand strategy, brand design, brand engagement and brand effectiveness our clients across the world include NASA Artemis, Unilever, Coca-Cola, Diageo, Mastercard, Intel, HSBC, Tencent, Twitch, Heineken, Reckitt and the BBC.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

About the role

The ECD / Creative Partner will be the senior creative lead and growth driver for the client relationship globally creating a strong vision for the growth of the brand.

The candidate needs to combine creative authority, brand design depth, FMCG understanding, innovation experience, entrepreneurial instinct and senior client leadership. They must be credible at C-suite level, including with the CMO and CEO, while staying close to the work.

This is a hands on role both in terms of driving great creativity and forming a very close partnership with our client. The role should be Netherlands-based or with frequent travel, making sure strong bonds and connection are formed with the work, the team and our client.

About you

A proven, hands-on creative leader with strong brand design credentials and the confidence to lead work for a global icon.

Deep understanding of FMCG, consumer behaviour, portfolio dynamics, innovation and the speed at which modern brands need to adapt.

Strong entrepreneurial instinct, with the ability to think beyond and spot opportunities across the wider business, markets and Brand & Design offer.

Credibility in high-level client conversations, including CMO, CEO and executive audiences.
The ability to challenge constructively, build trust quickly and create clarity in a complex organisation.

A visible creative leader who can inspire the internal team, attract strong talent around the account and set a clear creative standard.

Why us?

We’re passionate about our people and their careers. We’ll help you develop your skills and provide you with outstanding benefits. So you’ll have a chance to make your mark on our future, as we make a mark on yours. We’re proud to be the world’s most awarded brand design agency, with 28 Cannes Lions to our name and Creative Review Annual’s Most Creative Design Agency of the Year 2024. You’ll get to take new projects to award-winning potential, as part of a connected team of brilliant, tenacious people right by your side and across the world.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Design Bridge and Partners, a WPP company, is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Due to the volume of applications, we unfortunately can only respond to successful candidates.
We will not accept unsolicited CVs or approaches via recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Welche Aufgaben warten auf dich?

Tierliebhaber ist eine deutschsprachige Direct-to-Consumer Pet-Supplement-Brand, die mit echtem Direct-Response-Marketing wächst — VSLs und Long-Form-Funnels auf Meta. Wir schreiben, was konvertiert.

Wir suchen jemanden, der oder die beides kann: strategisch denken und selbst schreiben. Die Stelle ist keine reine Koordinationsrolle. Du bist der kreative Kopf hinter unseren Ads — vom ersten Briefing bis zur fertigen Creative-Performance-Analyse.

Was du tun wirst

VSL-Konzepte entwickeln und Skripte schreiben — für Meta und YouTube
Detaillierte Creative-Briefings erstellen, die Editor:innen und UGC-Creators eigenständig umsetzen können — Eng mit dem Founder-Team zusammenarbeiten
kurze Kommunikationswege, schnelle Entscheidungen
Creative-Performance aus dem Ads Manager lesen, Hypothesen ableiten, neue Iterationen briefen
Creative-Rotationen planen und einen strukturierten Testing-Prozess aufbauen

Was bringst du mit?

Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Creative / DR Copywriting
idealerweise im DTC-E-Commerce
Nachweisbare Ergebnisse mit Meta Video Ads (VSLs, UGC-Style, Hook-Testing)
Fähigkeit, starke Briefings zu schreiben, die ohne dich im Raum funktionieren
Sehr gutes Deutsch — du schreibst Copy, die sich liest wie ein Brief an eine gute Bekannte, nicht wie ein Beipackzettel
Verständnis für Consumer Psychology, Hooks, Storytelling-Strukturen (PAS, DIC, Before/After etc.)
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten — du brauchst keinen, der dir sagt, was als nächstes zu tun ist

Nice to have: Erfahrung im Pet-Markt, Kenntnisse im Advertorial-Funnel-Aufbau, Erfahrung im veterinärnahen Content (Tiergesundheit, Supplements, Naturheilkunde).

Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht. Ein kurzes Anschreiben ist nötig. Zeig uns aber insbesondere Arbeitsproben: ein VSL-Skript oder ein Briefing, das du erstellt hast.

Was bieten wir dir?

Das Arbeiten in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Kommunikationswegen und schnellen Entscheidungen.
Du arbeitest 100% remote.
Direkter Zugang zum Founder
Kein 9-to-5: Du kannst deine Arbeitszeiten bei uns flexibel gestalten.
Du freust dich am Monatsende über eine leistungsgerechte Entlohnung.
Preisnachlässe auf unsere Produkte, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und Team-Events sind ebenfalls Bestandteil unseres Angebots an dich.

Über uns

Was im Herbst 2016 in einer Berliner “Studentenbude” begonnen hat, ist heute eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Pet Health Unternehmen in Deutschland. Nach wie vor bilden natürliche Futterergänzungen als Alternative zu konventionellen Behandlungen das Fundament von Animagus GmbH. Mit der Kraft der Natur für gesunde, glückliche Haustiere sorgen - das ist und bleibt die Mission. Eine Mission, der sich bis heute über 500.000 Kunden angeschlossen haben…

jobs.title: Creative Strategist UGC & Performance Ads (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Social Heaven, part of trafficdesign | 100 % remote möglich, oder aus unseren Büros in Köln und Hamburg | Vollzeit | ab sofort

Aufgaben
#deinestelle 🚀

Über 800 Ads im Monat. Über 1000 vorqualifizierte Creator im Pool. Wir geben unseren Kunden ein Versprechen
, das wir halten müssen: UGC Ads in 18 Tagen, mit halbierten CPCs und vierfacher CTR.

Damit das funktioniert, braucht es jemanden, der vor der Produktion denkt. Genau das ist deine Rolle. Du übersetzt Produkt, Zielgruppe und Performance-Daten in Angles und Konzepte, suchst die Creator aus, die diese Angles glaubwürdig tragen, und begleitest das Ganze bis zum fertigen Ad. Du bist dabei nicht im Hinterzimmer: Du sprichst direkt mit den Brands, präsentierst deine Konzepte und verantwortest, was am Ende ausgeliefert wird.

#deineaufgaben

🔥 Strategie & Angles:
Du gräbst dich in Produkt, Zielgruppe, Reviews und Wettbewerb ein und entwickelst daraus Angles, die den Nerv treffen. Pro Brand, pro Funnel-Stufe, pro Plattform.

🔥 Konzeption & Scripting:
Du schreibst Konzepte, Hooks und Skripte für UGC Ads, Street Interviews und Advertorials. So klar, dass ein Creator sie ohne Rückfragen umsetzen kann, so offen, dass die Persönlichkeit erhalten bleibt.

🔥 Creator-Auswahl:
Du wählst aus unserem Pool die Creator aus, die zur Marke, zur Zielgruppe und zum Angle passen. Typ, Sprache, Branche, Glaubwürdigkeit, alles muss stimmen. Wenn niemand passt, sourct ihr gezielt nach.

🔥 Briefing & Begleitung:
Du briefst Creator, beantwortest Rückfragen, gibst Feedback auf Rohmaterial und steuerst Nachdrehs, wenn etwas nicht sitzt.

🔥 Qualitätssicherung:
Du sichtest, was reinkommt, und entscheidest, was rausgeht. Markenfit, Aussage, Compliance, Schnittfassung. Was dein Okay hat, geht zur Kundin.

🔥 Kundenkommunikation:
Du bist für deine Brands die Ansprechperson für alles Kreative. Du präsentierst Konzepte, holst Feedback ein und ordnest es ein, steuerst Freigaben und Abstimmungsschleifen und sagst auch mal begründet Nein. Aus Ergebnissen und Kundenzielen leitest du die nächste Welle ab.

🔥 Creative Data:
Du schaust dir an, welche Hooks, Creator und Formate performt haben, und nimmst die Learnings in das nächste Konzept mit. Testing-Logik statt Bauchgefühl.

Qualifikation
#wasdumitbringst

🤝 Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, UGC, Social Advertising oder Content-Konzeption, gerne aus Agentur, DTC-Brand oder Creator-Umfeld

🤝 Du weißt, was eine Ad verkauft und was nur schön ist. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR und CPA sind für dich Arbeitsmaterial, nicht Reporting-Deko

🤝 Du kannst schreiben: Hooks, Skripte, Briefings, auf den Punkt und in der Sprache der Zielgruppe

🤝 Ein gutes Auge für Menschen: du erkennst, welcher Creator eine Botschaft glaubwürdig trägt

🤝 Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen, auch wenn Feedback mal unbequem ist

🤝 Struktur und Eigenverantwortung, gerade im Remote-Setup

🤝 Perfektes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

🤝 Du findest dich in unseren Werten wieder: Kundenbegeisterung, Authentizität, Qualitätsversprechen, Zuverlässigkeit und ein freundschaftliches Miteinander

Benefits

Social Heaven ist Teil von trafficdesign

Für dich heißt das: Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, schnellen, remote-first Team mit kurzen Wegen und viel Gestaltungsraum. Gleichzeitig hast du die Struktur einer großen Agentur im Rücken. Media Buyer, die dir sagen, wie deine Creatives wirklich performt haben. Analytics und Account Management, die du nicht selbst aufbauen musst. Zwei Büros, in die du kommen kannst, wenn du Lust auf Menschen hast. Weiterbildungsbudget, Coaching und ein Benefit-Paket, das du als kleine Content-Agentur sonst nicht bekommst. in Berlin. Wir kreieren hochwertige digitale Produkte und Marken, deren Designs sich durch Schlichtheit und Innovation ausdrücken. Wir sind keine Fließband-Agentur; wir sind Digitalstrateg:innen, die Marken für die Märkte der Zukunft transformieren.

Unser Ziel ist ambitioniert: wir wollen zu den Top 10 der erfolgreichsten Marken- und Digitalteams
in Deutschland gehören. Dafür suchen wir eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die Markenführung auf Exzellenz-Niveau beherrscht und gleichzeitig die operative Intelligenz besitzt, ein wachsendes Team zu skalieren.

Mit unseren 30+ Account Manager:innen, Designer:innen und Entwickler:innen betreuen wir Kund:innen wie immowelt, WWF Deutschland und die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG)
.

Aufgaben
Als Design Director bei LAUDO bist du Hüter:in unserer kreativen Vision. Du bist verantwortlich für die Qualität jedes einzelnen Projekts, das unsere Agentur verlässt, und stellst sicher, dass unsere Arbeit strategisch überzeugt.

Du setzt den Standard für das, was wir unter “Design-Exzellenz” verstehen. Du forderst das Team heraus, über den Status Quo hinauszudenken und innovative Lösungen zu finden, die den Markenkern treffen.

Du verwandelst ein homogenes Team in eine Performance-Einheit. Durch „rationalen Optimismus“ und radikale Autonomie schaffst du einen Rahmen, in dem Designer:innen Verantwortung übernehmen und zur Höchstform auflaufen. Wir wollen die beste Arbeit unserer Karriere machen, du schaffst den Rahmen dafür.

Du führst Kund:innen mit Empathie und Autorität durch Marken- und Digitalprojekte. Du bist kein Dienstleister, sondern ein strategischer Partner, der komplexe Entscheidungen sicher begründet.

Du bist zu gleichen Teilen exzellent in der Gestaltung und empathisch in der Führung, inspirierst das Team und machst gleichzeitig selbst mit.

Du schaffst die Strukturen für Kreativität. Du optimierst Workflows (besonders in Richtung Development) und führst Projekte gemeinsam mit unserem Director Brand & Digital Strategy zum Erfolg.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung in etablierten Agenturen und hast bereits bewiesen, dass du Teams durch Skalierungsprozesse führen kannst.

Du hast ein außergewöhnliches Portfolio, das zeigt, wie du Markenwelten über alle digitalen und physischen Touchpoints hinweg zum Leben erweckst.

Du willst die beste Arbeit deiner Karriere machen und beweist, dass kompromisslose Qualität durch Führung und Freiraum entsteht.

Du verstehst Design- und Markensysteme und wendest sie als strategische Grundlage an. AI-Tools, Figma und die Adobe Cloud sind dein natürliches Habitat.

Du bist „Coach“, kein „Boss“. Du sprichst Probleme direkt an, nimmst dein Team empathisch mit und kommunizierst präzise auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Die Qualifikationen sind uns wichtig aber noch wichtiger sind uns Menschen, die uns mit ihrem unaufhaltsamen Drive überzeugen. Bewirb dich auch dann, wenn du nicht alle Qualifikationen erfüllst aber andere Fähigkeiten hast.

Remote Work:
Jede:r in unserem Team kann remote arbeiten und unsere Infrastruktur ist darauf ausgerichtet

Wir glauben an Individualität. Wenn du morgens deine Fokuszone hast, perfekt. Wenn nicht, auch kein Problem, wir respektieren deine innere Uhr

Plane deinen nächsten Urlaub ohne komplizierte Prozesse und spreche dich einfach nur mit deinem Team ab

Wir haben die 4-Tage Woche bei uns eingeführt und jeder 2. Freitag ist damit für alle frei. Bei gleicher Menge an Urlaubstagen

Werde stolze:r Besitzer:in des neuesten Apple MacBook Pro's. Außerdem steht dir Software wie die Adobe Cloud kostenlos zur Verfügung

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

You start your day partnering with business teams to uncover opportunities where AI can simplify work, improve productivity, and create measurable business value. As an AI Implementation Specialist, you will design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions, agents, copilots, and automated workflows that help teams work smarter and more efficiently. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong consulting mindset to turn innovative ideas into scalable solutions. You will also champion AI adoption by helping colleagues understand what is possible and enabling them to realize the full potential of emerging technologies. Every day brings new opportunities to transform the way we work through practical and impactful AI innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Identify, design, and implement AI use cases that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and deliver measurable productivity gains.
Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents, copilots, and automated workflows that support business objectives.
Drive AI adoption through training sessions, workshops, and hands-on coaching for business teams.
Ensure AI solutions comply with Siemens Energy standards, AI governance requirements, InfoSec guidelines, and release processes.
Develop scalable and reusable AI solutions while continuously introducing innovative capabilities and new ways of working.

What You Bring

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Informatics, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, AI agents, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Services, OpenAI technologies, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical AI solutions.
Fluent English skills; experience with enterprise AI deployments, AI governance, cybersecurity, compliance requirements, and change management is considered an advantage.

About The Team

You will join a collaborative and forward-thinking environment focused on accelerating AI adoption and digital transformation across the organization. The team works closely with business functions to identify high-impact opportunities, implement innovative AI solutions, and empower employees to maximize the value of emerging technologies. Together, you will help shape the future of work by creating scalable, secure, and business-driven AI capabilities that drive efficiency and innovation across the company.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Growth Content Lead based in Portugal.

This role offers the opportunity to lead an end-to-end content growth engine for a fast-moving product in the cryptocurrency and financial technology space.

You will set the overall content strategy, define the brand voice, and lead specialists across SEO, video, social, technical writing, and design.

The position combines strategic leadership with hands-on copywriting, particularly across landing pages, lifecycle email, product messaging, and PR communications.

You will connect content performance to measurable business outcomes, including organic acquisition, conversions, signups, and customer acquisition cost.

A major focus will be translating complex crypto and tax concepts into clear, trustworthy, high-converting experiences for users.

You will operate with significant autonomy, empowering a distributed team while continuously improving workflows, content quality, and channel performance.

This is an opportunity to shape the narrative of a growing product while building a scalable, data-informed content operation.

Accountabilities

Lead the overall content strategy and operating model across written content, SEO, video, social, technical writing, and related channels.
Manage and mentor channel specialists, setting clear objectives and KPIs, providing feedback, removing blockers, and supporting professional development.
Own the editorial calendar, content pipeline, workflows, and resource allocation across writing, design, video, and other content functions.
Define, implement, and maintain a consistent tone of voice and editorial framework across articles, scripts, emails, social content, landing pages, and brand communications.
Aggregate channel performance and drive content-led growth, monitoring signups, conversion rates, organic acquisition, and customer acquisition cost.
Develop and execute lifecycle marketing initiatives, including email campaigns, automated onboarding sequences, and newsletters.
Lead communications for major product launches, product announcements, partner initiatives, and release updates.
Personally write and refine high-impact copy, including landing pages, lifecycle email sequences, brand messaging, PR communications, and thought-leadership content.
Work closely with SEO, video, social, technical writing, and design specialists to ensure content channels operate as a coordinated growth engine.
Translate complex cryptocurrency, tax, and technical concepts into accessible, persuasive, and trustworthy content.
Use analytics, search data, conversion performance, and customer insights to identify opportunities and direct team priorities.
Establish streamlined processes that allow specialists to operate autonomously while maintaining consistently high editorial standards.
Build and continuously improve the content growth strategy based on user intent, funnel performance, and measurable business outcomes.
Lead the initial 90-day priorities, including establishing the tone-of-voice framework, improving editorial workflows, auditing lifecycle and conversion content, and creating a performance baseline.

Requirements

5+ years of relevant experience in content marketing, growth content, product marketing, editorial strategy, or a closely related field.
Proven experience building or scaling a product-led content operation, preferably within an early-stage, scaling, founder-led, or B2C SaaS environment.
Deep, hands-on knowledge of cryptocurrency and Web3, including practical experience with wallets, exchanges, DeFi platforms, or related products.
Native or near-native English proficiency, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to write high-converting copy, with a portfolio containing work such as landing pages, email sequences, educational content, or brand messaging.
Strong expertise in developing and enforcing a distinctive brand tone of voice across multiple content formats and channels.
Proven people-management and leadership experience, including managing content specialists, creators, or channel leads.
Strong understanding of SEO, search intent, organic acquisition, lifecycle marketing, conversion optimisation, and content funnels.
Experience coordinating multiple content channels and aligning their performance toward shared acquisition and growth objectives.
Strong data literacy and familiarity with analytics, including tools such as GA4, search performance data, conversion metrics, and attribution.
Ability to translate complex technical or financial topics into clear, actionable, and persuasive content.
Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on approach and willingness to personally execute high-impact content work.
Excellent editorial judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.
Ability to work with significant autonomy, make decisions quickly, and thrive in a high-velocity environment.
Experience in fintech, tax, personal finance, technical SaaS, or other product-led software environments is an advantage.
Experience taking content channels or products from early-stage development to measurable growth is a plus.

Benefits

Compensation: USD $80,000–$90,000 per year on a B2B contractor basis.
Fully remote position for candidates based in Europe.
32 days of paid time off.
100% asynchronous working culture with a flexible schedule.
High level of autonomy and ownership over strategy, execution, and team development.
Opportunity to work in the rapidly evolving cryptocurrency and financial technology sector.
Direct impact on organic acquisition, product growth, content strategy, and brand positioning.
Opportunity to lead and develop a multidisciplinary content team.
Fast-moving, founder-led environment with minimal bureaucracy and significant freedom to experiment.
Meaningful opportunities for professional growth and strategic responsibility.
Remote-first collaboration with an international team.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Growth at Revolut is where strategy, data, and creativity come together. The team drives expansion by launching in new markets, accelerating acquisition, and boosting engagement and retention. They turn insights into action, working across teams and channels to scale what works and experiment with what’s next.

We’re looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to support mobile acquisition efforts. You’ll be managing campaigns across key platforms and analysing performance to improve efficiency and growth. You’ll also work on attribution and tracking, ensuring accurate measurement in a privacy-first ecosystem.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing

Managing and optimising mobile campaigns across Google UAC, Meta, TikTok, and Apple Search Ads
Analysing campaign performance data to improve ROAS and scale efficiently
Supporting attribution setup and troubleshooting using AppsFlyer or Adjust
Working with SKAN and ATT frameworks to ensure accurate tracking
Collaborating with Product, Data, and Engineering teams on measurement challenges
Monitoring KPIs and contributing to reporting and performance insights
Running experiments (A/B tests, bidding, creatives) to improve results
Identifying trends and opportunities within mobile marketing and attribution

What You'll Need

1+ years of experience managing performance marketing campaigns or academic exposure
A degree in mathematics, computer science, economics, engineering, or related field
Experience with mobile ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads)
Expertise in analysing data and solving quantitative problems
A solid understanding of mobile attribution tools (AppsFlyer, Adjust, SKAN, ATT)
The ability to work with large datasets and extract actionable insights
A KPI-driven mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes
The ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
Impeccable communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams
Fluency in English

Nice to have

Experience with SQL or Python
A background in computer science or quantitative disciplines
Familiarity with automating reports or bid strategies
An understanding of marketing in a regulated industry

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

About us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.

We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We're looking for a Creative Director with strong ideas, great visual taste and a real understanding of Spanish culture and consumers, combined with solid international experience.

This person will work primarily across brands and projects with a strong focus on the Spanish market, spanning food, lifestyle, FMCG and other consumer categories.

We're looking for someone who understands the Spanish market deeply, but has also worked with international brands, teams and clients, bringing a broader creative perspective to the work.

As Creative Director, you'll lead creative development across brands, from campaign platforms and launches to social, activations, partnerships, content and brand experiences.

The work can vary significantly from brief to brief. One project might require a big emotional campaign for a household brand. Another might be a food or lifestyle launch that needs to feel desirable and contemporary. Another might start with a global platform that requires a strong local expression rather than simply a translated headline.

You'll work closely with Strategy, Copy, Art Direction, Social and Production teams to develop work that is culturally relevant, visually strong and commercially effective.

Develop strong campaign ideas and creative platforms for Spanish and international consumer brands.

Partner closely with Strategy to understand audiences, behaviors and cultural insights, and turn them into creative opportunities.

Develop original campaigns for the Spanish market, as well as local expressions of global brand platforms.

Understand the nuances of Spanish culture, humor, language and consumer behavior without relying on obvious cultural clichés.

Bring experience from international brands and markets into the work while ensuring ideas remain relevant to local audiences.

Develop ideas across film, social, OOH, digital, retail, experiential, PR, partnerships and content.

Understand how creative should work across different stages of the funnel and across different channels.

Recognize when a brief needs a big campaign idea and when the stronger solution may be an activation, collaboration, creator partnership, product experience or social-first idea.

Create work around products that feels desirable and contemporary, particularly within food, lifestyle and FMCG categories.

Develop culturally relevant ideas around talent, creators, entertainment and partnerships.

Lead campaigns from concept through production, protecting both the idea and the quality of execution.

Present and sell creative work confidently to clients.

Lead, inspire and develop multidisciplinary creative teams.

Creative Leadership & Strategic Thinking

Strong conceptual thinking and creative problem-solving skills.

Ability to identify the bigger creative opportunity behind a brief and transform it into a compelling campaign platform, not just an execution.

Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and collaborating closely with strategists.

Strong understanding of the Spanish market, its consumers, language, humor and cultural nuances.

Ability to develop authentic, culturally relevant work that resonates locally.

International Perspective

Experience working with global brands, international clients or multicultural teams.

Contemporary visual taste with a strong eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and the visual language of modern consumer brands.

Ability to balance product storytelling with brand-building, creating work that is both commercially effective and culturally engaging.

Understanding of how brands can participate in culture through talent, creators, partnerships, experiences and social channels.

jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.

We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work.

Backed by Tier 1 investors from Europe and the US such as Headline and Creandum, and with more than 30,000 craftspeople as our customer base, we are scaling across Europe to turn individual, scattered businesses into connected and successful communities.

We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people wearing safety boots in mind, not suits. We’re excited to shape the future together as a team, staying grounded in our mission to empower the builders and makers of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Performance Marketing Manager (f/m/d)
at plancraft, you take ownership of Paid Social channels (e.g. Paid Social, Paid Search, or Programmatic) and drive its performance end-to-end. You execute, analyse, and continuously optimise campaigns based on data, while identifying scalable growth opportunities within your domain. You contribute to a high-performing marketing setup by bringing deep channel expertise and translating insights into clear, actionable improvements.

Your Responsibilities

Own the performance of Paid Social channels end-to-end — from setup and execution to optimisation and reporting
Plan, launch, and continuously optimise campaigns based on clear KPIs (e.g. CPA, ROAS, pipeline impact)
Analyse campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights to improve results
Run structured experiments (A/B tests) and scale successful approaches within your channel
Collaborate closely with Brand, Content, and RevOps to improve creatives, messaging, and funnel performance
Support the development of tracking, attribution, and reporting setups to enable reliable decision-making
Identify and test new opportunities within your channel to unlock additional growth
Stay up to date with platform developments, trends, and automation or AI-driven improvements

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves:

2–3+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing in a data-driven environment
Deep expertise in the main Paid Social channels (e.g. Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn), ideally gained within a larger performance marketing team
Proven experience owning and optimising campaigns within your channel with clear performance impact
Strong analytical skills and ability to derive actionable insights from data
Experience with common tracking and analytics tools (e.g. GA4, Google Tag Manager or similar)
Experience running structured tests and applying data-driven optimisation approaches
Solid understanding of performance metrics across the funnel
Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style
Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently within your scope
Strong communication skills in English (C1/C2 level)

Nice-to-haves:

Experience in SaaS or B2B tech environments
Exposure to additional paid channels beyond social
Experience with attribution models or more complex tracking setups
Experience supporting international campaign scaling
Interest in applying AI tools to improve campaign performance and efficiency

WHY PLANCRAFT?

Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.
Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.
International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, France, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked
to shape the future, #together
as a team, and #humble
in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram
and LinkedIn page
.

Diversity makes us better.

We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here
. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Lead production for the Seasonal Content organization, overseeing the planning, execution, and successful delivery of every MONOPOLY GO! season.
Own the operational health of the seasonal portfolio, balancing player experience, content quality, novelty, production predictability, resource utilization, and business objectives—not simply delivery against schedule.
Drive the long-term evolution of the seasonal content pipeline, continuously improving how art, design, narrative, gameplay content, rewards, licensed IP, localization, and live operations move from concept through launch.
Own content roadmap planning, art capacity planning, outsourcing strategy, and resource forecasting to maximize both creative ambition and sustainable execution.
Partner closely with Product, Art, Design, Live Operations, Marketing, and Licensing leadership to align priorities across multiple concurrent seasonal initiatives.
Operate comfortably at both the executive and production floor levels—providing strategic direction while remaining actively involved in milestone reviews, dependency management, issue resolution, production planning, and critical decision making.

Drive executive-level visibility through clear reporting, production health metrics, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations.
Champion continuous improvement across production methodologies, governance, tooling, AI adoption, and content development workflows.
Lead organizational change initiatives that improve how teams plan, collaborate, and execute, ensuring new processes are successfully adopted across multiple disciplines.
Serve as a diplomatic leader who builds trust across diverse teams, navigates competing priorities with empathy, and facilitates alignment during high-pressure or ambiguous situations.
Mentor Production Managers and Producers while raising the overall maturity and effectiveness of production across the Seasonal Content organization.

What We're Looking For

Extensive experience leading production within large-scale live-service game development environments.
Deep expertise managing content-heavy production pipelines, including art production, outsourcing, IP development, localization, approvals, and live seasonal releases.
Demonstrated success operating as a Production Director or equivalent leader responsible for both organizational strategy and execution.
Proven ability to seamlessly shift between strategic leadership and hands-on production management, remaining deeply connected to execution while guiding long-term organizational direction.

Exceptional understanding of creative development pipelines and how to optimize art and content production without sacrificing quality or innovation.

Excellent judgment balancing player experience, creative ambition, technical constraints, production risk, and business priorities.
Outstanding communication, organizational leadership, and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with rapidly evolving priorities and complex cross-functional organizations.
Passion for building high-performing teams, enabling creative excellence, and delivering unforgettable seasonal experiences at world-class scale.

In this role, you'll be expected to actively incorporate AI into production workflows to improve planning, asset tracking, documentation, communication, forecasting, content review, dependency management, and operational decision-making. Experience working on category-leading live service games.
Experience within mobile free-to-play game development.
Experience leading globally distributed development teams.
Experience scaling production organizations during periods of rapid growth.

jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role,
but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.
Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.
Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.
Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.
Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.
Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.
Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.
A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.
Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.
Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.
Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills
Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

You’ll take ownership of the creative development and performance analysis behind our paid social advertising, with Meta as your primary focus.

Creative performance tracking and analysis

Develop concepts for video, static and carousel ads, including demonstrations, testimonials, founder stories, expert advice and offers.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself.
Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar.
The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar.
Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not.
You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Foundry
jobs.description:
At Instructure
, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.

We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. You’re the growth engine for the pods. In the core business, this work splits across product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle teams; here, it’s one person doing all of it — finding the message that lands, filling the early-access pipeline, and turning a working product into paying customers. You’ll set positioning, generate demand, and own the funnel from first touch to renewal, working hand in hand with Pod Founders who are selling as they build. This is a blank-page job: most pods start with no category, no audience list, and no playbook, and you’ll build all three. The role reports to the President, Foundry, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Marketing leadership.

What You’ll Do

Own positioning and messaging. Craft the value proposition, naming, and packaging input for products customers have never heard of, and maintain messaging frameworks by segment across K12, higher education, and business and government.
Run go-to-market and launch. Own go-to-market readiness for pilots, early access, and general availability — timelines, channels, pricing input, and the launch assets that carry the story.
Build the demand engine. Generate pipeline through campaigns, audience building, early-access recruiting, and the top of the funnel that feeds the Founder’s selling.
Drive content. Create the collateral, digital content, and customer-facing assets that build demand and make the differentiation obvious.
Be the market and customer expert. Become the go-to expert on the portfolio’s customers and competitors, and feed that insight back into product and pricing.
Own lifecycle and adoption. Once customers land, drive adoption, expansion, and retention with consistent, value-based messaging.
Measure and adjust. Track funnel and campaign performance against pipeline and revenue, and change course fast when the numbers say so.

What You’ll Need

Five or more years in product, portfolio, or growth marketing, ideally in ed tech or a related industry, with new-product launches under your belt.
A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.
Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.
Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.
The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.
A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.

This Role Isn’t For Everyone

You should probably pass if:

You want to own one slice — just messaging, or just campaigns — and hand off the rest.
You need an established brand and a built-in audience to market into. Here you build the category.
You measure success by impressions and activity rather than by pipeline and revenue.
You want a large marketing organization with clear lanes. This is one person, broad scope, and fast.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.
Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.
Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.
Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support
Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth
The technology and tools you need to do your best work
Motivosity employee recognition program
A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month.
With a powerhouse portfolio
across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

LADbible’s Commercial Team, LAD360, is a powerhouse of creativity, strategy, and innovation - partnering with the world’s most iconic brands, from Google and Nike to Disney and Tesco. With a headcount of 150 and growing, LAD360 has rapidly become one of the most formidable forces in media, delivering culture-shaping campaigns. Our work has earned us top industry accolades, including Commercial Team of the Year
at the 2025 Campaign UK Awards and Media Brand of the Year
at the 2024 MediaWeek Awards. At the heart of it all is a relentless drive to push boundaries, tell bold stories, and connect brands to youth culture like no one else can.

About the Role

LADbible's commercial team is looking for an Associate Creative Director
who understands what makes young women laugh, gets them talking, and matters to them. With a focus on Betches UK, this is an opportunity to shape bold, funny, culturally relevant content that connects with a Gen Z audience.

We’re looking for someone with a passion for women’s issues and lifestyle, a sharp sense of humour, and the ability to turn audience insights into standout, social-first branded content.
You’ll define what great looks like across both partnership campaigns and platform output, guiding the team from initial spark through to delivery.

You’ll lead creative ideation across short-form video, memes, reactive content and talent-led formats, creating work that feels native, entertaining and true to Betches UK’s voice. From dating and friendships to careers, pop culture and the issues shaping women’s lives, you’ll know how to find the relatable truth and turn it into something worth sharing.

This role sits at the heart of the team, leading and inspiring a multidisciplinary group of creative producers, editors, creators, and talent partners to deliver work that earns attention and drives real impact.

What the opportunity looks like

Lead the creative development of women’s lifestyle branded content, with a focus on BETCHES UK, ensuring ideas feel native to the platform and true to the brand’s voice.
Apply and evolve successful content formats into partnership work, while developing new formats that connect with young women.
Oversee creative output across owned social channels, ensuring consistency, quality and platform relevance.
Own the end-to-end creative output, maintaining a high standard across both always-on content and campaign moments.
Shape and manage the idea pipeline, balancing reactive content with bigger, format-led executions.
Champion humour and an authentic female perspective, finding fresh ways to reflect the experiences, interests and issues that matter to our audience.
Lead, mentor and inspire the wider creative team, providing clear direction and elevating the quality of ideas and execution.
Act as the senior creative voice in client conversations, turning briefs into strong, simple ideas and presenting them clearly and confidently.
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure ideas are both ambitious and deliverable within fast-paced production timelines.
Stay tapped into Gen Z culture, platform trends and audience behaviour, ensuring all output feels current and relevant.

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

Significant experience within a social-first creative, editorial or advertising environment, operating at a senior or leadership level.
A proven track record of developing standout branded content that feels native to the platform, with a portfolio that demonstrates a strong instinct for humour.
A passion for women’s issues and lifestyle, with an understanding of the different perspectives and experiences within a young female audience.
Deep Gen Z cultural fluency, from creators and internet humour to the conversations shaping young women’s lives.
Strong leadership skills, with experience guiding multidisciplinary teams and improving creative output.
Experience working with established content formats and evolving them for different brands or audiences.
Ability to think strategically while maintaining a strong grasp of execution, including comic timing, tone of voice and storytelling.
Confidence working with and influencing senior stakeholders, both internally and client-side.
Deep understanding of content performance and what drives engagement across key social platforms.
Excellent writing and pitching skills, with the ability to shape and sell ideas clearly and convincingly.
Comfortable balancing long-term creative direction with rapid, reactive content cycles.
